schema_gaps: The current LiteratureAtom schema has no dedicated case-observation kind for isolated numeric clinical measurements that lack a modeled intervention or comparator. These case measurements are retained as atom_kind=other rather than forced into quantitative_result.
extraction_limitations: This is a two-patient case report without a comparator group, prespecified outcomes, or inferential statistics.
Clinical management statements in the Discussion partly summarize cited literature and should not be treated as effect estimates generated by these two cases.
All model-extracted atoms remain needs_review because no independent human reviewer step is represented.
No external current-practice verification was performed because @VERIFY was not activated.
